text:
maria: heads-up — after the gateway rollout we started seeing duplicate billing events for the same request_id (~3% of recent traffic). noticed retries + partial ack cases. anyone seen this pattern before? :eyes:
ingest-bot: DUPLICATE_DETECTION_ALERT - 1961239900 - 42 events in 5m matching request_id pattern 'req_*' (possible retry storm).
ajay: I saw a few of these last week during the load test. Gateway retries + flaky downstream ack seems likely. Two quick levers: 1) stronger dedupe key at ingress 2) idempotency token propagated from client.
sasha: +1. we should decide where dedupe lives: gateway vs ingest service. gateway-level dedupe avoids extra work but needs a small state store / LRU with eviction policy. ingest-level dedupe is simpler on gateway but pushes cost downstream.
maria: thinking: gateway should include an explicit "idempotency-token" header when available, otherwise compute a dedupe_key = sha256(request_id + model + user_id). store that key on the gateway for short window (5m) and drop duplicates early. open to other windows.
kevin: tradeoffs: short window reduces memory but misses long-delayed duplicates. long window increases storage & write amplification on the gateway. also: false dedupe if token reused across legitimately separate attempts (client bugs). We need an audit trail.
ajay: example event envelope we used in staging that worked pretty well:
```json
{"dedupe_key": "sha256(...)", "request_id": "req_abc123", "idempotency_token": "tok-xyz", "user_id": "acct_42", "model": "redwood-alpha", "ts": 1961239888, "payload": {...}}
```
With that the ingest service just indexes dedupe_key and returns 200 if seen.
sasha: for auditability, don't throw away full original event. Instead write full event to a cold audit log (S3) and write a lightweight pointer/marker to hot dedupe store. Hot store = redis TTL + occasional compaction job. Cold store used for billing reconciliation/backfills.
devon: +1 on pointer approach. also we need a clear eviction/rollback story when we realize we dropped real unique events. propose: keep full events for 30d, pointers for 7d, dedupe window default 10m but configurable per-customer.
maria: config per-customer is important for Dedicated/Private. enterprise customers might want longer windows. we should also expose metrics: billing_duplicates_count, dedupe_hits, dedupe_misses, audit_backfill_errors.
kevin: question: how do we handle model-fallback cases where gateway swaps model_variant (fallback to smaller model) and both attempts generate events that are semantically the same billing unit? we might over-dedupe if dedupe_key includes model.
ajay: we can include an optional "billing_unit_key" that normalizes equivalence classes (e.g., same prompt+user -> same billing unit) and prefer that for dedupe when present. default continues to be request-level dedupe.
sasha: and add a flag in ingress that marks whether the event was generated from a fallback path so auditors can see it: fallback=true/false. that helps chargeback clarity.
maria: action items: 1) ajay + kevin draft gateway dedupe PR with redis LRU TTL and metrics (ETA: 2d) 2) sasha + devon draft audit storage contract (pointers vs full events, retention) (ETA: 3d) 3) add schema field "billing_unit_key" to event contract and bump minor version (ingest contract owners) 4) add runbook snippet for late duplicate detection and manual reconcile steps.
kevin: I'll own infra for the redis cluster for short-lived dedupe keys. ajay will own schema and gateway change.
devon: for backfill: recommend a reconciliation job that replays cold logs against dedupe pointers and emits a report of possible over/under charges for the last 30d. schedule weekly after deploy.
maria: thanks all. I'll open the RFC follow-up thread and collect the PR links. cc @sasha @ajay :thumbsup:
